name: Funeral Home Operations
audience: independent funeral homes and small death-care service teams
topic: arrangement readiness, service-vendor handoffs, and personal-effects accountability

products.name: Arrangement Readiness Board
products.product: A focused funeral arrangement document readiness tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent funeral homes and small death-care service teams
products.problem: Family decisions, vital information, authorizations, permits, contracts, obituary assets, merchandise selections, payment, and third-party confirmations mature at different times before services.
products.valueProposition: Turns funeral arrangement document readiness tracking into a visible operating queue so every case has human-reviewed required decisions, documents, authorizations, and exceptions visible against the actual service timeline.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets funeral arrangement checklist, funeral home case readiness, funeral document tracking, and funeral service planning software searches.

products.name: Service Vendor Handoff
products.product: A focused funeral service vendor and facility handoff tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent funeral homes and small death-care service teams
products.problem: Clergy, celebrants, cemeteries, crematories, florists, musicians, newspapers, venues, escorts, and transport providers receive changes through separate calls without one accepted operating plan.
products.valueProposition: Turns funeral service vendor and facility handoff tracking into a visible operating queue so every external service commitment has current instructions, accountable contacts, accepted timing, change history, and verified completion.
products.topic: funeral service vendor and facility handoff tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets funeral vendor coordination, funeral service checklist, cemetery confirmation tracker, and funeral event planning software searches.

products.name: Personal Effects Custody
products.product: A focused funeral home personal effects chain of custody workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent funeral homes and small death-care service teams
products.problem: Jewelry, clothing, documents, devices, containers, keepsakes, and other personal effects can pass through removal, preparation, arrangement, service, and release without consistent item-level acknowledgment.
products.valueProposition: Turns funeral home personal effects chain of custody into a visible operating queue so every personal effect is inventoried with appropriate privacy, transferred through named custody events, and released or disposed only with authorized acknowledgment.
products.topic: funeral home personal effects chain of custody
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets funeral home personal effects, death care chain of custody, funeral property inventory, and personal effects release form searches.
